name: Addressable loop powered red Compact Combined Sounder/Beacon – INTERTEK Approved

subcategory.name: Analogue Addressable Audio Visual & Voice Alarms

family: Loop Powered Addressable Sounders, Beacons And SounderBeacons
summary: The Context Plus red Addressable loop powered Compact combined sounder/beacon is third-party certified to EN54-3 (Sounders), EN54-23 (VADs) and 17 (Isolators) by Intertek.
description: Provides ‘W-3-3.1’ light distribution when wall mounted (min 0.4 lux over a 3 x 8m cylindrical area).
Can also provide ‘C-3-8’ light distribution when ceiling mounted (min. 0.4 lux over a 3 x 3.1m cuboid area).
features: Provides 'W-3-3.1' light distribution when wall mounted (min 0.4 lux over a 3 x 8m cylindrical area).
Can also provide 'C-3-8' light distribution when ceiling mounted (min. 0.4 lux over a 3 x 3.1m cuboid area).
14mA alarm current @24V DC (VAD lit, sounder on max).
Group addressing facility allows multiple devices to be operated simultaneously.
7 selectable volume levels and up to 15 selectable tone pairs.
